GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Rdr reported the gelding travelled comfortably through the middle stages, however when placed under pressure in the home straight it did not respond to his riding and was disappointing in the manner in which it closed the race off. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover until the 700m when settling outside the leader. When questioned, rdr stated he was required to make use of his mnt to take up a forward position from a wide barrier. He said after having to press forward to cross passing the 800m, his mnt tended to race keenly, and due to these factors it came under heavy pressure prior to straightening, gave no response to riding and weakened noticeably over the final 300m. A post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities. Tnr rep subsequently reported in light of the gelding’s disappointing performance, it has been spelled.
